style.toneOfVoice: Serve up some Christmas fun with this charming LEGO Gingerbread Man Minifigure Christmas tree decoration and make this the Christmas the sweetest yet. Perfect for LEGO fans and collectors, this ornament features a Gingerbread Man from the LEGO universe with a huge smile on his face and holding a red mug with the message Drink me! . Made from sturdy plastic with a white ribbon hanging loop, it s ready to hang on your Christmas tree or mantlepiece. Hallmark Ornaments are a great way to commemorate hobbies, life events and individual interests in movies, games and more. Ornament Measures: 6.3cm by 3.1cm by 5cm. This is not a toy. For decorative use only.
